 Malin Akerman and Brittany Snow join TODAY to talk about the upcoming second season of their hit Netflix show “The Hunting Wives” and what has people so hooked. “It’s like the most escapism type of television,” Brittany says. They also reveal how they’ve raised the bar for Season Two. “We had to go harder, we had to go bigger” Malin teases. Nov. 17, 2026
